instruction: Please navigate to the Privacy & Security settings section in Thunderbird. I want to access the privacy configuration options.

metadata.explanation: Task requires opening the Privacy & Security settings tab in Thunderbird. The evaluator checks the accessibility tree for a tab named 'Privacy & Security'. This follows the same pattern as opening other settings tabs.

Metric logic is correct: check_accessibility_tree (general.py:216-267) properly parses CSS selectors and checks element existence in accessibility tree

Complete coverage: instruction requires navigating to 'Privacy & Security settings section', evaluator verifies both tab existence (name='Privacy & Security') and active selection (attr|selected='true')

Parameter handling is correct: get_rule returns config['rules'] directly, check_accessibility_tree receives rules list as second parameter and iterates properly (line 242: 'for r in rules:') - no type='rule' parameter handling errors
Postconfig appropriate: lines 45-101 reopen settings dialog (Alt+E, s) ensuring UI state is available for verification after agent actions

Selector semantics correct: 'application[name=Thunderbird] page-tab-list[attr|id="tabmail-tabs"]>page-tab[name="Privacy & Security"][attr|selected="true"]' verifies correct tab is selected, not just present
No logic gaps: evaluator can definitively determine if the Privacy & Security settings section was successfully navigated to
